headline: Win more events, collect every payment and see your real profit on each one
seo_title: Wedding and Event Planning System in Excel – Profit per Event
seo_description: Run your events from 8 connected Excel workbooks: proposals, payments, budgets by guest, vendors, RSVPs, run-of-show, team and profit. 15 languages.
description:
See which events really make money after vendors and labour, who still owes you a deposit and where a budget is about to overrun – before you promise the next date or sign the next supplier. This is a complete back office for wedding and event planning in Excel: eight connected workbooks that already work with sample data, so you see every alert and dashboard before you type your first enquiry.

Built for owner-planners with a small team of coordinators and freelance crew running weddings, corporate events, conferences and private parties for paying clients, venues and suppliers.

What you get:
✓ 8 connected workbooks: enquiries, proposals and contracts; clients, payments and invoicing; event budgets and costing by guest count; vendors, bookings and payments; guests, RSVPs and seating; timelines and day-of coordination; team, tasks and capacity; business finance and growth
✓ {pages} ready pages: dashboards, calculators, printable forms and checklists, and ready WhatsApp messages
✓ 15 languages, each as a blank template, with filled sample-data copies in English
✓ Standard xlsx files for Microsoft Excel and LibreOffice – no macros, no subscription

How it works: 1) open the workbook in your language, 2) type your enquiries, payments, vendors, guests and hours in the yellow cells, 3) proposal prices, payment alerts, budget overruns, seating, run-of-show and profit per event update by themselves. One payment, instant download.
features: Turn enquiries into signed contracts with a proposal price for every guest count
Collect every deposit and balance on time with due dates, reminders and late-payer flags
Set budgets by guest count and see an overrun before it happens, not after
Know the real profit of each event after vendors, labour and the reserve
Replace a vendor who cancels fast, with a second choice and the cost already worked out
See every vendor deposit and balance due in the next 13 weeks
Count RSVPs, plus-ones and children into one head count for the caterer and venue
Seat every guest with no table over capacity and every request checked
Send the kitchen exact meal counts and never lose an allergy
Build a minute-by-minute run-of-show and catch overlaps and late vendors before the day
Check team capacity and hours before you say yes to another event
See your cash 13 weeks ahead and the events you need each month to break even

faq.a: No. The files are standard xlsx files for Microsoft Excel and LibreOffice, which is free.

faq.q: Does it fit a solo planner and a larger team?
faq.a: Yes. It works for one planner and for a business with several coordinators and freelance crew; the sample data shows an owner-planner, five coordinators, six crew, forty vendors, twelve venues and fifty-six events.

faq.q: Can I replace the sample data with my own?
faq.a: Yes. Every workbook comes in 15 languages as a blank template, plus filled sample-data copies in English, so you can explore first and start clean when you are ready. Each fact is typed once and every dashboard reads it from there.

faq.q: Can I use my own currency, fees and targets?
faq.a: Yes. Currency, planning fee, markup, deposit shares, category shares, target margin, cash safety level and due-day rules are on the settings and list sheets, and every formula follows your changes.
Start with Part 1 for enquiries and proposals, or with the part that hurts most today, such as payments or vendors. Each workbook works alone and links to the others as you fill it.

faq.q: Are there macros or a subscription, and how do I receive it?
faq.a: No macros and no subscription. You pay once and download a ZIP at once with every workbook in all 15 languages.
